name: Bento Grid UI
summary: A rectangular grid of rounded cells of mixed spans, each holding one idea, with equal small gaps between them. Apple feature pages made it the default product layout from 2022.

philosophy.core_thesis: A page is easiest to scan when every idea sits in its own compartment and the compartments tile one tight, regular grid.
design_principles: Divide the page into a 4-column or 12-column grid and let each cell span 1, 2 or 3 columns and 1 or 2 rows.
Keep one uniform gap of 12px to 16px between all cells, and never mix gap sizes.
Give every cell a radius of 20px to 28px and use the same radius on all cells of a page.
Put one message in each cell: a headline of at most 8 words, one visual or one number.
Make the feature cell 2 by 2 and fill the other cells at 1 by 1 or 2 by 1, so that sizes give the order of importance.
Fill cells with 2 to 4 tints of one family, plus one or two cells in the accent colour.
Align cell contents to the same inner padding of 24px, and anchor text at the top left or the bottom left.
anti_patterns: Gaps of different sizes between cells in one grid
Empty holes in the grid that break the rectangle
Cells with different corner radii on one page
Several messages or calls to action in one cell
More than 8 cells in the first viewport
Heavy borders or hard shadows that fight the tiling
Paragraphs of more than 30 words inside a cell

layout.grid_mechanics: A 4-column grid on desktop with 16px gaps and rows of 200px to 280px; cells span 1 to 3 columns and 1 to 2 rows, and the grid collapses to 1 or 2 columns below 768px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: Gaps take 5–8% of the area; open space moves inside the cells, where padding is 24px to 32px; the spacing scale is 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Cell edges align to the grid on both axes; text inside a cell is left-aligned and anchored to the top or the bottom; the whole bento block is centred in a container of 1120px to 1280px.
layout.container_geometry: Cells are rounded rectangles with a 24px radius and no outer margin; the cell aspect ratios are 1:1, 2:1 and 1:2, and the visuals inside are clipped to the same radius.

font_pairings.note: Tight display sizes for short cell headlines.
A single family at weights 400, 500 and 600.
A warmer display face for consumer products.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.03em; body stays at 0; small captions take +0.01em.
hierarchy_rules: Set the feature cell headline at 40px to 56px, other headlines at 20px to 28px and captions at 14px.
Use weight 600 for headlines and 400 for captions; use a muted colour at 4.5:1 for secondary lines.
Limit a headline to 8 words and a caption to 20 words, because the cell has little room.
Pair a large number at 64px or more with a 14px caption for each key metric.

color.palette_structure: A neutral page, cells in two to four tints of one family at low saturation, and one or two accent cells that cover about 15% of the grid.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on Cell gives about 17:1 and Graphite on Cell gives about 5:1; white text on Accent Blue gives about 4.7:1, which passes WCAG AA for body text; keep every cell pair at 4.5:1 or better.
color.surface_treatment: Flat or near-flat fills; cells may hold a photograph, a product render or a gradient of two close tints, and a cell never mixes more than one surface type.
color.light_and_shadow: Mostly none; an optional 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) shadow or a 1px border of rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) separates white cells from the page.

materiality.surface_simulation: None; the cells read as compartments of a lacquered lunch box, but the surface is flat colour or imagery and imitates no material.
materiality.border_rules: No border by default; a 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) border appears where a white cell sits on a white page; dark mode uses 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1).
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Blur is 0px by default; elevation is limited to a 0 1px 2px shadow on the page and a 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) lift on hover.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Simple icons with a 1.5px to 2px stroke and round caps at 24px to 32px, in Ink or in white on accent cells; one icon at most per cell.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Product renders, UI screenshots and large numbers, cropped to the cell radius; abstract gradients fill empty cells.

motion.transition_physics: Cells enter in a stagger of 40ms to 60ms, fading in and rising 12px; on hover a cell scales to 1.02 and its shadow deepens; neighbours do not move.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales the cell to 1.02 and adds a 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) shadow; active scales to 0.98; focus adds a 2px Accent Blue ring offset by 2px.

emotion.target_response: Ordered curiosity: the viewer feels that the product is organised, compact and easy to scan in seconds.

avoid_when: The content is long-form prose, because cells of at most 30 words break an argument into fragments.
The items have a strict order or a ranking that a reader must follow from top to bottom.
The content is uneven or sparse, because a grid with fewer than 5 cells leaves visible holes.

modifiers.how: Set the radius to 0px, remove cell fills and divide cells with 1px rules; keep the 12-column grid and the type scale.
Fill cells with rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) and backdrop-filter blur(20px) over a gradient page; keep the gaps and the radius.
Add a 3px black border and a 4px 4px 0 0 #000000 shadow, and fill cells with loud flat hues; keep the grid and the 16px gap.
Remove the shadows and borders, and use solid cell fills with no photography; keep the 24px radius and the gap.

pack.why: A plain round line at one weight: quiet in a cell, the default of current product interfaces.

ground.why: Bento layouts sit on a quiet grid, and the cells give all the structure.
